scenes.heading: Genotype and phenotype
scenes.sub: Why identical twins still look a bit different
scenes.say: Identical twins share all their alleles, yet they still look a little different. How? Let's separate genotype from phenotype.

scenes.heading: Think of it like this
scenes.everyday: Same recipe, different kitchens, slightly different loaves
scenes.breaks: A cook can rewrite a recipe, but the environment doesn't change the genotype, only how it's expressed.
scenes.say: Two people follow the same banana bread recipe, but one oven runs hot. The loaves come out different. The recipe is the genotype, the kitchen is the environment, and the loaf is the phenotype. But the environment doesn't rewrite your alleles. It changes how they're expressed.

scenes.heading: Writing genotypes
scenes.say: Use a capital letter for the dominant allele and the same letter in lower case for the recessive one. Homo means same, so T T and little t little t are homozygous. Hetero means different, so capital T little t is heterozygous.
scenes.caption: Use a capital letter for the dominant allele and the same letter in lower case for the recessive one. Homo means same, so TT and tt are homozygous. Hetero means different, so Tt is heterozygous.

scenes.heading: Dominant vs recessive

left.title: Dominant
points: TT and Tt look the same

scenes.say: Think of a lamp with two bulbs. If even one works, the room is lit, so you can't tell T T from T t. Only when both are dead is it dark: that's little t little t. Often, one working allele makes enough protein. Only the recessive tells the truth.
scenes.caption: Think of a lamp with two bulbs. If even one works, the room is lit, so you can't tell TT from Tt. Only when both are dead is it dark: that's tt. Often, one working allele makes enough protein. Only the recessive tells the truth.

scenes.heading: Environment changes phenotype
points: Hydrangeas: soil pH sets blue or pink
Siamese cats: dark fur on cool parts
scenes.say: The environment can change phenotype without changing genotype. Hydrangeas flower blue or pink depending on soil pH. Siamese cats grow dark fur on their cooler ears, nose, paws and tail. And in PKU, a special diet from birth largely prevents the harmful effects.

scenes.heading: Worked example
scenes.question: Black fur (B) is dominant to white (b). A white and a black guinea pig have some white offspring. What are the parents' genotypes?
lines: Black parent is BB or Bb
White offspring need a b from each parent
scenes.say: Black fur is dominant to white. A white and a black guinea pig have some white babies. The white parent must be little b little b. A white baby needs a little b from each parent, so the black parent must be capital B little b: heterozygous.
scenes.caption: Black fur is dominant to white. A white and a black guinea pig have some white babies. The white parent must be bb. A white baby needs a b from each parent, so the black parent must be Bb: heterozygous.

scenes.heading: Epigenetics
scenes.say: Epigenetics is like muting an app rather than deleting it. DNA methylation and histone modification switch genes on or off without changing the DNA sequence. Diet, stress and smoking can change these marks.

Quick recap. Phenotype equals genotype plus environment. Homozygous means the same alleles, heterozygous means different. A dominant allele shows with just one copy. And epigenetics changes switches, not spelling. Now try the practice questions!
